title: Interactive workshop with lots to learn
quote: The workshop was interesting and very interactive. Mr. Chapman's use of anecdotes and the different activities really helped me understand the importance of communication. the ITD material, especially identification of your work style model was an important insight into how to improve my own work by effective communication. Analysing these models also helped me understand how to effectively communicate with colleagues, seniors as well as clients.
author: Mihika
subject: Personality at Work
